enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Remain motionless. Snore. Turn again. Continue sleeping.

Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower tap. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower tap. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around waist. Walk to sink. Turn on sink tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off sink tap. Wipe face with towel. Hang towel. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk, eggs, and butter. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Pick up frying pan. Place on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs with fork. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Stir eggs with spatula. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Place eggs on plate. Pick up bread. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Wait for toast. Pick up toast when ready. Place on plate. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Pour milk into glass. Pick up plate and glass. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat breakfast. Pick up fork. Use fork to eat eggs. Pick up glass. Drink milk. Finish eating. Stand up. Pick up plate and glass. Walk to sink. Rinse plate and glass. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed, packing work bag and reviewing the day's program schedule on the Computer
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open work bag. Place laptop in bag. Place notebook in bag. Place pen in bag. Close work bag. Walk to desk. Turn on desk lamp. Sit down. Turn on computer. Open program schedule file. Read schedule. Make notes. Save notes. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up. Pick up work bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read messages. Put phone away. Stand up. Pull cord. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press elevator button. Wait for elevator. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office door. Open door. Enter office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, coordinating community programs and meeting partner organisations
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Attend meeting. Greet partner. Shake hands. Sit down. Discuss program details. Take notes. Stand up. Say goodbye. Walk to desk. Sit down. Make phone calls. Coordinate volunteers. Update program documents. Print documents. Collect printouts. File documents. Walk to colleague's desk. Discuss event logistics. Return to desk. Continue working on computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to café. Enter café. Stand in line. Order sandwich and coffee. Pay. Receive food. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat sandwich. Drink coffee. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Throw away trash. Walk back to office. Enter office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, planning upcoming community events and handling administrative tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Open event planning file. Review event checklist. Make phone calls to vendors. Send emails to participants. Update event budget. Print receipts. File receipts. Attend team meeting. Discuss event timeline. Take notes. Return to desk. Order supplies online. Update database. Prepare report. Print report. Submit report. Organize desk. Shut down computer.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Read news. Put phone away. Look out window. Stand up. Pull cord. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk home. Enter home.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Cut chicken. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir chicken. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Stir. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Serve food onto plate. Pick up fork and knife. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat dinner. Cut food. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Finish eating. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table, loading the Dishwasher and tidying the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Place plates in dishwasher. Pick up glasses. Rinse glasses. Place glasses in dishwasher. Pick up utensils. Place utensils in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Wipe table with cloth. Wipe counter. Sweep floor. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the couch and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Pick up phone. Check social media. Put phone down. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking personal email and preparing notes for tomorrow on the Computer
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open notes app. Write notes for tomorrow. Save notes. Close computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and completing evening hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower tap. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply shampoo. Rinse hair. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Walk to sink. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wipe face. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading under the DeskLamp and winding down for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Read. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Continue lying.
Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Remain motionless. Snore. Turn again. Continue sleeping.
